_note: Verses the eBible NET USFM drops text from, restored from the previously shipped NET pack (bolls.life text) which carries them in full.  The defect is systematic: each of these verses loses a span containing place names -- Matthew 2:1 ends at "Bethlehem" and jumps to verse 2; Joshua 7:2 reads "men from Jericho ) and instructed". Confirmed by reading the raw USFM, and each entry was checked against BSB for the same verse so a verse the old text had merged or bloated was not pulled in. Verses where the old pack merged two under (21:1)-style versification notes are deliberately excluded: the USFM versification is the correct one.  Structure markers still come from the USFM; only the wording is replaced. Regenerate by diffing a rebuilt pack against a known-good NET text.
